items.title: Roy McCurdy interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: But I’ve worked with Joe several times and I really love him

ctx.x: Did you ever have an opportunity to play behind Joe Williams?
Sure. I love Joe. We did an album with Cannon and Joe, a live record for Fantasy Records I believe it was.
He did some nasty Blues on that record.
